name: io.github.oaslananka/easyeda-mcp-pro
description: MCP server for EasyEDA Pro: PCB inspection, BOM, exports, and hardware review.

environmentVariables.name: NODE_ENV
environmentVariables.description: Environment mode

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Pino log level

environmentVariables.name: TOOL_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Active tool profile (core, pro, full, dev, experimental)

environmentVariables.name: TOOL_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma- or space-separated capability scope allowlist; empty enables all scopes allowed by the active tool profile.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PROTOCOL_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: MCP protocol version string

environmentVariables.name: MCP_BRIDGE_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Bridge backend: local_bridge or experimental remote_relay

environmentVariables.name: MCP_REMOTE_SESSION_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional fixed Remote Relay session id for the remote_relay backend

environmentVariables.name: TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Server transport mode (stdio or http)

environmentVariables.name: HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: HTTP bind address

environmentVariables.name: HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP port

environmentVariables.name: HTTP_AUTH_DISABLED
environmentVariables.description: Disable HTTP transport authentication

environmentVariables.name: HTTP_RATE_LIMIT_MAX
environmentVariables.description: Max requests per minute per IP

environmentVariables.name: CORS_ORIGIN
environmentVariables.description: Allowed CORS origin for HTTP transport

environmentVariables.name: ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of allowed origins for HTTP transport (use * for wildcard)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TASKS_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Reserved; currently non-functional: parsed for compatibility, but the server does not advertise or execute MCP Tasks.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_APPS_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Reserved; currently non-functional: parsed for compatibility, but no MCP Apps UI or resource runtime is registered.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_V2_EXPERIMENTAL
environmentVariables.description: Reserved; currently non-functional: does not change MCP protocol negotiation.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_RAW_EXEC_EXPERIMENTAL
environmentVariables.description: Experimental second gate for raw EasyEDA runtime execution; requires BRIDGE_RAW_EXEC_ENABLED.

environmentVariables.name: BRIDGE_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bridge WebSocket host for EasyEDA Pro connection

environmentVariables.name: BRIDGE_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Bridge primary port

environmentVariables.name: BRIDGE_PORT_SCAN
environmentVariables.description: Port scan specification (comma-separated ports or ranges)

environmentVariables.name: BRIDGE_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Bridge call timeout in ms

environmentVariables.name: BRIDGE_HEARTBEAT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Bridge heartbeat interval in ms

environmentVariables.name: BRIDGE_WAIT_FOR_EDA_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long to wait for EasyEDA Pro to become available on startup (ms)

environmentVariables.name: BRIDGE_MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE
environmentVariables.description: Max bridge payload size in bytes

environmentVariables.name: BRIDGE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Session token for extension auth

environmentVariables.name: EASYEDA_DEV_BRIDGE
environmentVariables.description: Enable EasyEDA dev bridge mode

environmentVariables.name: BRIDGE_RAW_EXEC_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Experimental first gate for raw EasyEDA runtime execution; requires MCP_RAW_EXEC_EXPERIMENTAL.

environmentVariables.name: DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Base directory for writable local state; defaults beneath the operating-system user home directory.
environmentVariables.placeholder: Defaults to the operating-system user home directory under .easyeda-mcp-pro.

environmentVariables.name: SQLITE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: SQLite database path; derived from DATA_DIR unless explicitly configured.
environmentVariables.placeholder: Derived from DATA_DIR as easyeda-mcp-pro.sqlite unless explicitly configured.

environmentVariables.name: ARTIFACT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Artifact export directory; derived from DATA_DIR unless explicitly configured.
environmentVariables.placeholder: Derived from DATA_DIR as artifacts unless explicitly configured.

environmentVariables.name: CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Cache directory; derived from DATA_DIR unless explicitly configured.
environmentVariables.placeholder: Derived from DATA_DIR as cache unless explicitly configured.

environmentVariables.name: AI_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Reserved; currently non-functional: no in-process AI provider client is invoked.

environmentVariables.name: AI_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Reserved; currently non-functional: no model is selected or invoked.

environmentVariables.name: AI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Reserved; currently non-functional: do not supply credentials because no provider client consumes them.

environmentVariables.name: AI_MAX_TOKENS
environmentVariables.description: Reserved; currently non-functional: retained only for future provider compatibility.

environmentVariables.name: AI_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Reserved; currently non-functional: retained only for future provider compatibility.

environmentVariables.name: AI_ALLOW_DESIGN_MUTATIONS
environmentVariables.description: Reserved; currently non-functional: cannot enable AI-originated design mutation.

environmentVariables.name: JLCPCB_MODE
environmentVariables.description: JLCPCB API mode (disabled, mock, approved_api)

environmentVariables.name: JLCPCB_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: JLCPCB API client identifier.

environmentVariables.name: JLCPCB_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: JLCPCB API client secret

environmentVariables.name: JLCPCB_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: JLCPCB API base URL

environmentVariables.name: JLCPCB_ENABLE_ORDERING
environmentVariables.description: Enable JLCPCB ordering

environmentVariables.name: JLCSEARCH_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Enable LCSC component search

environmentVariables.name: JLCSEARCH_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: LCSC search API base URL

environmentVariables.name: LCSC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: LCSC API key

environmentVariables.name: KEYLESS_SOURCING_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Allow supported public keyless component-sourcing fallbacks when vendor credentials are unavailable.

environmentVariables.name: SOURCING_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Component-sourcing cache lifetime in seconds (0 disables cache reuse).

environmentVariables.name: VENDOR_MIN_REQUEST_INTERVAL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Minimum delay in milliseconds between outbound requests to the same sourcing vendor.

environmentVariables.name: MOUSER_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Enable Mouser integration

environmentVariables.name: MOUSER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Mouser API key

environmentVariables.name: MOUSER_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Mouser API base URL

environmentVariables.name: DIGIKEY_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Enable DigiKey integration

environmentVariables.name: DIGIKEY_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: DigiKey OAuth2 client identifier.

environmentVariables.name: DIGIKEY_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: DigiKey OAuth2 client secret

environmentVariables.name: DIGIKEY_SANDBOX
environmentVariables.description: Use DigiKey sandbox environment

environmentVariables.name: DIGIKEY_LOCALE
environmentVariables.description: DigiKey locale

environmentVariables.name: DIGIKEY_CURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: DigiKey pricing currency

environmentVariables.name: OAUTH_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Enable OAuth for HTTP mode

environmentVariables.name: OAUTH_ISSUER
environmentVariables.description: Expected OAuth token issuer

environmentVariables.name: OAUTH_AUDIENCE
environmentVariables.description: Expected OAuth token audience

environmentVariables.name: OAUTH_JWKS_URI
environmentVariables.description: JWKS endpoint for token signature validation

environmentVariables.name: OAUTH_REQUIRED_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Required OAuth token scope

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Reserved; currently non-functional: no OTLP exporter is started.

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Reserved; currently non-functional: retained for a future OTLP exporter.

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Reserved; currently non-functional: retained for a future OTLP exporter.

environmentVariables.name: TRACE_SAMPLE_RATE
environmentVariables.description: Reserved; currently non-functional: no OTLP traces are emitted.
